title: LodMesh
description:
The surfaces of one block of level of detail, in game units. Numbers
are little-endian and Base64-encoded, as in [`MeshShape`].

LodShape.description: One surface of a block of level of detail.

alphaTest.description: Whether the transparent parts of the texture are left out.

indices.description: The triangles: three 32-bit point numbers each.

texture.description:
The colour texture, below the data directory, to be fetched once
for every surface that uses it. A surface of land without one is
water.

uvs.description: The texture coordinates: two 32-bit floats per point, or empty.
